cohort: Seventy-four nulliparous women, aged 18-45, who underwent cesarean sections.
finding: Lecoxen cream significantly improved wound healing (in terms of redness, edema, ecchymoses, and discharge) and scar quality (vascularization, pigmentation, flexibility, and height) following cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Lecoxen cream proved to be a safe and efficient treatment for wounds and scars specifically derived from cesarean sections.
